::: {#sol-chebyshev-loose}

```{r}
#| label: chebyshev-loose
#| code-fold: false
normal_approx <- 2 * pnorm(-1 / sqrt(sigma2 / n_min))
normal_approx
```

The bound is loose
because the sample [mean](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-vectors.html#def-mean) of this many cars is nearly [normal](random-variables.qmd#def-normal)
(@thm-clt),
and the normal approximation puts the chance of a miss at about
`{r} signif(normal_approx, 2)`.
Chebyshev's inequality must hold for every distribution, as in
@exm-chebyshev-auto.

:::
